---
title: "DNA-Hosted Silver Nanoclusters"
description: "Kamruzzaman Joty’s research on voltage-dependent translocation and electrolyte stability of DNA-hosted silver nanoclusters using solid-state nanopores."
subtitle: "Voltage-dependent transport and electrolyte stability"
---

DNA-hosted silver nanoclusters combine a DNA template with nanoscale silver clusters. Solid-state nanopore measurements provide a way to examine their transport and stability.

## Research question

How do applied voltage, pore geometry, and electrolyte conditions affect the translocation signals and stability of DNA-hosted silver nanoclusters?

## Approach and contributions

I investigated voltage-dependent translocation and electrolyte-dependent stability, comparing DNA templates with and without silver nanoclusters across pore geometries and applied voltages. Experimental signal analysis examined the effects of cluster formation and electrolyte conditions.

## Publication and cover

[Joty et al., ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces (2025)](https://doi.org/10.1021/acsami.5c02405) reports the complete methods, results, and limitations.

The publication was featured on a supplementary journal cover. [View the cover gallery](../covers.qmd).
